title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: PNC Pavilion, Cincinnati | 2016
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the PNC Pavilion in Cincinnati, Ohio, USA, on 22 June 2016.

It was the 15th show of the 12th All-Starr Band’s tour of North America and Asia, which lasted for 42 dates between June and November 2016.

Starr had previously performed at the PNC Pavilion on 9 July 2010.

The 12th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion, keyboards
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar
  • Gregg Rolie: vocals, organ, keyboards
  • Todd Rundgren: vocals, guitar, harmonica, bass, percussion, keyboards
  • Richard Page: vocals, bass guitar
  • Mark Rivera: vocals, saxophone, percussion, keyboards, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums
